failures.rule: brand/constitution.md Part III App margins; Article 7.5; Part IV B17
failures.place: Left edges of Today, the offer field, item photos, and the sale amount.
failures.issue: With the phone content normalized to 390 px wide, Today and the offer field begin about 14–15 px from the edge rather than the required 20 px. Photos and the You keep label begin about 23 px in, while the amount and its band start farther left. The primary content does not hold one start edge.

The band begins near the bottom of the figures and extends substantially below their baseline, leaving a conspicuous empty colored strip. It is not confined behind the lower 40% of the figures as specified.

across_options.issue: The offer-field texture changes independently of typeface: A has more pronounced curved mesh lines; B and C have finer, fainter diagonal lines. Texture strength is the separate open decision D5 (brand/ledger.md), not D2; brand/constitution.md Article 14.4 calls for variants on one named axis.

The field, Sold pill, and money-highlight colors vary. B has a brighter, more yellow lime than A, while C has another yellow-green treatment. For example, a corresponding interior Sold-pill pixel at normalized (160,505) is RGB (222,234,67) in A, (222,243,69) in B, and (219,235,55) in C. These fill changes are unrelated to D2; see brand/ledger.md A1 and brand/constitution.md Article 14.4.

Divider strength/color also drifts: the rule above Nike Dunks is stronger/bluer in A and C and fainter in B. This is a surface-treatment change, not a consequence of the selected typeface (brand/constitution.md Article 14.4).
